err_range: Roman numerals here go from 1 to 3999.
err_chars: "{0}" is not a Roman numeral. Use I, V, X, L, C, D and M.
err_repeat: {0} cannot appear more than three times in a row.
err_sub: "{0}" is not a valid subtraction. Only IV, IX, XL, XC, CD and CM are allowed.
err_order: The symbols are not in the standard order.
empty_hint: Type a number or a Roman numeral above; the other field fills in by itself.
rule1: Symbols are written from largest to smallest and added: XVI = 10 + 5 + 1 = 16.
rule2: A smaller symbol before a larger one is subtracted, only in the six pairs IV, IX, XL, XC, CD and CM.
rule3: I, X, C and M may repeat up to three times in a row; V, L and D never repeat.
rule4: Each decimal place is written separately: 1994 = M (1000) + CM (900) + XC (90) + IV (4).
quiz_hint: Enter checks the answer, then Enter again for the next question.
reset_msg: The session score, the best streak and the all-time totals will be cleared.
